management.note: Management returned approximately $26.0 billion to shareholders in Q2 fiscal 2027 and retained approximately $99.0 billion of repurchase authorization.

margins.note: Q2 fiscal 2027 GAAP gross margin was 75.0%, up from 72.4% in the prior-year quarter.

growing.note: Tesla reported second consecutive quarter of trailing-twelve-month revenue above $100 billion and delivered 486,532 vehicles in Q3.

moat.note: Tesla reported Cybercab entering the Austin robotaxi fleet and FSD supervised attach rate above 75% of North American deliveries.

management.note: Management continued investment in robotaxi, robotics, energy, and manufacturing programs while reporting a $1.9 billion increase in cash and investments.

items.summary: Source-linked AI summary: Q3 2026 revenue and advertising metrics grew strongly, but operating margin declined and free cash flow was negative after heavy investment and a legal charge.

growing.note: Q3 2026 revenue increased 26% year over year, with ad impressions up 10% and average price per ad up 14%.

moat.note: Family daily active people averaged 3.64 billion in September 2026, up 3% year over year, supporting platform scale.

management.note: Management continued substantial AI and Reality Labs investment while reporting a $9.89 billion legal charge in the quarter.

margins.note: Q3 operating margin fell to 20% from 40% in the prior-year quarter, partly due to the legal charge.

cash.note: Q3 operating cash flow was $32.79 billion, but free cash flow was negative $2.12 billion after $34.91 billion of capital expenditures.

risk.note: The quarter included a legal charge related to an agreement with 52 state attorneys general providing for payments of up to approximately $18.59 billion.

timing.note: Q4 2026 revenue guidance was $73 billion to $76 billion, but current valuation evidence was not established.
